remarks: Located in a convenient mid-city complex, this two bedroom, one bath first floor unit sits in the corner of the beautifully landscaped courtyard. Hardwood floors enhance the living room and hallway while the kitchen boasts a brand new wood-like vinyl floor. The kitchen cabinets and entire unit are freshly painted and professionally cleaned and the bathroom is under five years old. Walk to everything that your daily needs require. The super market, restaurants, gym, park, bus line and more are just steps away. Common charges include property maintenance, heat and hot water and the common laundry and storage area are in the basement of the next building. Owner must live in the unit for at least a year before renting it out.
